prompt:
You are a senior ML researcher generating candidates only; do NOT rank, reject, assert novelty, or declare publishability. Return exactly one JSON object shaped {"shard_id":"lens:verifiable-role-interaction","candidates":[{"kind":"idea","title":...,"method_steps":[...],"falsifiable_hypothesis":...,"minimum_experiment":...,"contribution_type":...,"risk":...,"effort":...,"closest_prior_families":[...],"so_what":...,"dedup_key":...}]} with 6-8 candidates.
Direction: design a publishable multi-agent architecture for causal online capacitor degradation forecasting (capacity, ESR, SOH, RUL) using LLM API agents combined with small numerical forecasting/prognostic models. Accuracy on unseen capacitors is first priority. Every candidate must respect rolling-origin, delayed label maturity, LOCO/cross-condition tests, no future leakage, numeric scoring, and failure-safe fallback. The architecture—not mere application—must be research focus.
Known close work: REATS already does LLM ensemble weighting; CastFSR/CastFlow fast numeric prior + slow LLM/reflection/memory; Nexus macro/micro agents; TS-Debate modality-specialized debate with verifier/code tools; DynaSwarm/MasRouter dynamic agent graphs; AGORA graph orchestration; last-mile agent revision. Avoid simply repeating those.
Lens: role factorization with deliberately non-overlapping causal views, typed evidence/claim edges, deterministic numerical verification, conflict attribution, independent shadow judges, and small-model/physics tool use. Seek mechanisms whose necessity can be isolated by edge/node ablations under equal token/call budgets. Moderate compute only; no subjective LLM scoring.
